Reading this view

Positive delay means late; negative delay means early. Measured departure is reconstructed from the scheduled time and the City’s recorded deviation. These are departure outcomes, not arrival measurements. “Within ±2 minutes” is our comparison band, not an official service standard.

Quality flags preserve extreme delays (over one hour), additional duplicate candidates, missing categories, invalid required fields, and invalid coordinates. Excluding flagged records removes any flagged row. Unparseable delays are omitted from delay statistics, but remain in the record count and table unless excluded.

Use Bus trips & replay for histories with actual trip and bus identifiers collected from the API. Historical stop records cannot be reliably grouped into those bus histories from the source file alone.
